task: L1 subtractive-mask connectivity audit and repair
scope: 2D masks and diagnostics only; no CAD, STL, STEP, frontend, external frame, or specification edits
root_cause: The previous region extraction and sheet checks used 8-neighbour component labeling. Pixels touching only at a diagonal corner were therefore treated as connected even though their shared-edge width is zero.

connectivity_policy.width_method: Elliptically erode each physical mask by a conservative four-pixel radius, require every surviving core component to reach the common perimeter, then confirm every visible component touches the restored supported core.

fox_workshop.strict_width_search: No exact perimeter-connected sequence was found at the enforced seven-pixel contact threshold.

repair_policy.reason_for_order_change: The prior 17-layer order contains edge-disconnected sheets even though all pixels hidden by upper layers are already retained. A 4-neighbour region-graph replan is therefore necessary and yields 18 edge-connected sheets.

approval: L1 remains unapproved. Fox edge connectivity is repaired, but the configured width gate remains an explicit conflict requiring user direction.
